python3 << 'EOF'
import os
import re

# Files to fix
files = [
    '/app/pyknotid/pyknotid/spacecurves/openknot.py',
    '/app/pyknotid/pyknotid/spacecurves/knot.py',
    '/app/pyknotid/pyknotid/representations/dtnotation.py',
    '/app/pyknotid/pyknotid/representations/representation.py',
]

for filepath in files:
    if not os.path.exists(filepath):
        continue
    with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Replace n.int with int
    content = re.sub(r'\bn\.int\b', 'int', content)
    
    with open(filepath, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print(f"Fixed {filepath}")

print("All done!")
EOF
